content.short: Institutions use Sentora for non-custodial DeFi yield vaults with risk management and protocol cover built in.
content.description: Sentora packages DeFi for institutions that want yield without building their own risk desk. Its Smart Yield vaults hold strategies the team has stress-tested across several market cycles, with live analytics and cover against protocol failures. Past projects include running vaults for ether.fi and working with Paxos and PayPal to seed PYUSD markets on Solana. The firm says it has deployed more than $3 billion onchain, and it presents yield strategies, risk analysis and cover as one platform for institutions moving into DeFi.
